name: Net sales
source_labels: YTD Sales; R4 Sales; YTD RTL; LW RTL
evidence: S09 Export!D1; S13 Export!C1:D1; S15 Export!M1:Q1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Gross sales less discounts and returns, excluding sales tax; agree freight/services treatment.
grain_unit: SKU × store × day; finance reconciliation. Unit: USD.
aggregation_guards: Sum transactions in selected period and population.
decisions_questions: Treat RTL as a candidate sales measure, not confirmed net sales; returns, tax and channel policy remain open.

name: Net sales quantity
source_labels: YTD SQFT; R4 SQFT; R4 Units; YTD Unit Sales
evidence: S11 Export!E1:G1; S15 Export!AT1:BC1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Gross sold quantity less returned quantity, converted using effective-dated item UOM.
grain_unit: SKU × store × day; no mixed-unit total. Unit: Canonical UOM.
aggregation_guards: Sum only compatible quantities. Show cartons, each or sq ft explicitly.
decisions_questions: SQFT and units are distinct measures; neither label proves net treatment or conversions.

name: Gross margin dollars
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K03
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Net sales − recognized cost of goods sold; agree freight, rebates, shrink and return-cost policy.
grain_unit: SKU × store × day. Unit: USD.
aggregation_guards: Sum GM dollars, then reconcile with finance.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: Gross margin rate
source_labels: R4 GM %; R13 GM %; GM % YTD; GM % LY YTD
evidence: S10 Export!M1:N1; S15 Export!AE1:AG1; S16 Export!U1:X1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Sum GM dollars / sum net sales.
grain_unit: Same period and scope for numerator/denominator. Unit: %.
aggregation_guards: Ratio of totals; net sales <= 0 means rate unavailable with reason. Negative GM is valid.
decisions_questions: Observed percentages do not establish cost basis, weighting or returns. SKU GM restricted in S06 footer.

name: Average unit retail
source_labels: R4 ASP; R13 ASP; R4 ASP LY; Avg SQFT/EA Price
evidence: S03 top matrix; S15 Export!C1:D1,AR1:AS1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Sum net sales / sum net sales quantity.
grain_unit: Compatible UOM required. Never average row AUR. Unit: USD / UOM.
aggregation_guards: Ratio of totals; non-positive quantity gives no meaningful AUR.
decisions_questions: ASP/price labels are candidates; realized ASP is not automatically equivalent to ELP or chain price.

name: Sellable on-hand quantity
source_labels: Available Units; Store OH Qty; DC OH Qty
evidence: S02 SKU table; S04 inventory grid
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: On-hand less reserved, damaged, quarantined and otherwise unavailable quantities under agreed policy.
grain_unit: SKU × location × snapshot; DC separate. Unit: Canonical UOM.
aggregation_guards: Sum across SKUs/stores at one complete snapshot. Never sum across dates.
decisions_questions: Related observed labels are not proof of this exact metric. Observed physical/available quantities are related, but not proven equivalent to sellable on-hand.

name: Sellable on-hand cost
source_labels: OH$ Cost; OH CST$
evidence: S02 focus-group and SKU tables; S05 district table
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Sellable quantity × agreed inventory unit cost at the snapshot.
grain_unit: SKU × location × snapshot. Unit: USD at cost.
aggregation_guards: Sum same-date values. Show cost valuation method and exclusions.
decisions_questions: Related observed labels are not proof of this exact metric. Cost-valued on-hand is observed; the sellable portion is not established.

name: Ending inventory cost
source_labels: OH $; TOTAL OH$; OH$ Cost
evidence: S02 SKU table; S11 Export!O1; S15 Export!BL1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Inventory value at review-window end, using agreed inventory valuation and saleability categories.
grain_unit: SKU × location × review end. Unit: USD at cost.
aggregation_guards: One ending snapshot. Compare with original plan ending stock for identical cohort.
decisions_questions: Related observed labels are not proof of this exact metric. On-hand dollar is observed as a snapshot-like label; review-window ending-date, cost basis and sellability are not established.

name: Average inventory cost
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K09
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Sum daily inventory cost / number of complete daily snapshots.
grain_unit: Daily inventory history. Unit: USD at cost.
aggregation_guards: Average matched-day totals. Missing days are missing, not zero.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: Sell-through
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K10
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Net sold quantity / (opening sellable quantity + external receipts + net transfers into scope + agreed adjustments excluding customer returns).
grain_unit: SKU-store review cohort; transfer legs cancel inside combined scope. Unit: %.
aggregation_guards: Returns reduce net sold; do not also add them to denominator. Aggregate supply components first; suppress denominator <= 0. Flag impossible >100% for reconciliation.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure. Opening stock, transfers, receipts, returns and exact denominator require client sign-off; no source sell-through definition supplied.

name: Forecast EOP sell-through
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K11
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: (Actual net sales quantity to date + future forecast quantity) / full-period projected available supply.
grain_unit: Cohort × period × forecast version. Unit: % estimated.
aggregation_guards: Use forecast and receipt version; show estimated label. Do not treat as actual ST.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: Rate of sale
source_labels: R13 Avg SQFT/EA per Location; R4 Avg SQFT/EA per PWPS
evidence: S11 Export!B1; S15 Export!E1:F1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Net quantity / eligible store-days × 7.
grain_unit: SKU × store × day. Unit: UOM / eligible store-week.
aggregation_guards: Use exposure denominator across ranged open stores, including zero-sales days.
decisions_questions: This is a related volume velocity; source exposure and denominator are not proven and R4/R13 need confirmation.

name: In-stock rate of sale
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K13
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Quantity sold on in-stock eligible days / in-stock eligible store-days × 7.
grain_unit: SKU-store daily stock and range. Unit: UOM / available store-week.
aggregation_guards: Diagnostic demand proxy. Label exclusion of unavailable days; not true unconstrained demand.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: Backward weeks of supply
source_labels: WOS; Average WOS (Store)
evidence: S04 WOS column; S15 Export!BK1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Sellable on-hand / average weekly net quantity in selected trailing window.
grain_unit: Snapshot + matched trailing sales. Unit: weeks.
aggregation_guards: At aggregate level use summed stock and demand. No/negative demand: “No positive demand”, not zero coverage.
decisions_questions: Source WOS is observed, but backward versus forward and averaging basis are unknown. Zero or negative sales can cause Infinity in source (S08); source formula is unknown.

name: Days of supply
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K15
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Backward weeks of supply × 7, if using the same demand basis.
grain_unit: K14 components. WOH 17 cannot also mean DOS 17. Unit: days.
aggregation_guards: Label trailing window and confirm whether client uses a forward DOS definition.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: Forward weeks of supply
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K16
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Weeks covered by sellable on-hand using cumulative future weekly forecast; fractionally consume final covered week.
grain_unit: Snapshot + dated forecast horizon. Unit: weeks estimated.
aggregation_guards: Aggregate aligned weekly demand first. If stock exceeds horizon, show >horizon. Zero demand is explicit.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: In-stock rate
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K17
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Eligible ranged store-days with sellable stock > 0 / eligible ranged store-days.
grain_unit: SKU-store-day; exclude not-ranged and closed days. Unit: %.
aggregation_guards: Recompute weighted ratio. Threshold may become minimum presentation quantity after client approval.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: Stockout days
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K18
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Count eligible ranged open-store days with sellable stock = 0.
grain_unit: SKU-store-day. Unit: eligible store-days.
aggregation_guards: Sum exposure, not distinct dates across stores. Show missing snapshots separately.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: Approved buy quantity
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K19
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Sum quantity committed in original approved PLR buy plan at the plan grain.
grain_unit: SKU × destination/store or allocated plan grain × version. Unit: Canonical UOM.
aggregation_guards: Freeze plan version; separate planned buys from actual PO placements and receipts.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: Approved buy cost
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K20
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Sum approved planned buy quantity × planned unit cost.
grain_unit: Original approved plan. Unit: USD at planned cost.
aggregation_guards: Do not compare with retail sales as a buy accuracy measure.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: Receipts quantity
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K21
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Physical accepted inbound receipt quantity; distinguish vendor receipts from transfers.
grain_unit: SKU × destination × receipt date. Unit: Canonical UOM.
aggregation_guards: Sum event quantities in interval; avoid double counting ordered and received units.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: Open order quantity
source_labels: DC to Store OO Qty; On Order $ (DCs); On Order $ (Stores)
evidence: S04 inventory grid; S15 Export!BN1:BO1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Confirmed ordered quantity less received and cancelled quantity as of snapshot.
grain_unit: PO line × SKU × destination × as-of. Unit: Canonical UOM.
aggregation_guards: Snapshot measure with expected arrival date; not available stock.
decisions_questions: Quantity and value measures are distinct and PO versus transfer scope is unknown.

name: Unique ranged SKUs
source_labels: Count of SKU; ASTY SKU Count; SKU Count
evidence: S09 Export!B1; S14 Export!A1:C5; S16 Export!H1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Distinct sellable SKUs with active range in selected store scope on as-of date.
grain_unit: Effective-dated range. Unit: distinct SKUs.
aggregation_guards: Distinct union across stores; store breadth is separate. Preserve zero-sales SKUs.
decisions_questions: Observed count logic, SKU uniqueness and as-of status are unverified.

name: Unique selling SKUs
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K24
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Distinct SKUs with positive gross sales quantity in period, with returns reported separately.
grain_unit: Transaction history. Unit: distinct SKUs.
aggregation_guards: Distinct count at selected scope; never sum counts across weeks/stores.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: Ranged store coverage
source_labels: ASTY Locations; Active Assorted Locations
evidence: S06 SKU Performance grid; S15 Export!L1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Distinct ranged eligible stores for selected SKU / eligible open stores in chosen universe.
grain_unit: SKU × store × effective date. Unit: stores and %.
aggregation_guards: Show both counts. Do not infer range from nonzero stock or sales.
decisions_questions: Related observed labels are not proof of this exact metric. Counts of locations are observed; eligibility percentage denominator and historic status are not shown.

name: Range execution rate
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K26
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Original planned SKU-store pairs actually activated by target date / original planned pairs.
grain_unit: Frozen plan range + actual range history. Unit: %.
aggregation_guards: Fixed original denominator; late activations separate. Capacity cancellations remain explainable deviations.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: Net range changes
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K27
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Adds, drops and changed eligibilities since baseline, reported separately and as net adds minus drops.
grain_unit: Range event ledger. Unit: SKU-store pairs.
aggregation_guards: Pair-level distinct counts; a swap links two decisions rather than masking the pair changes.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: Sales variance to original plan
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K28
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Actual sales − original plan sales for elapsed weeks; divide by positive plan sales for %.
grain_unit: Original phased sales plan + actuals. Unit: USD and %.
aggregation_guards: Same cohort, calendar and channel. Missing plan is unavailable.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: Sales quantity variance to plan
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K29
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Actual net quantity − original phased demand plan quantity; % over positive planned demand.
grain_unit: Original phased demand plan + actuals. Unit: UOM and %.
aggregation_guards: Do not use buy quantity as forecast demand.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: Demand forecast WAPE
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K30
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Sum abs(actual quantity − frozen forecast quantity) / sum actual quantity at SKU-store-week grain.
grain_unit: Frozen pre-period demand forecast + actuals. Unit: % error.
aggregation_guards: Same exposure window; sum actual <=0 gives unavailable. Stockouts constrain observed demand.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure. Frozen demand forecast was not provided; observed sales are stockout-constrained.

name: Demand forecast bias
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K31
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Sum(forecast quantity − actual quantity) / sum actual quantity. Positive means overforecast.
grain_unit: Same grain and frozen version as WAPE. Unit: %.
aggregation_guards: Use positive actual denominator; label observed versus availability-adjusted actual basis.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure. Frozen demand forecast was not provided; observed sales are stockout-constrained.

name: Sales share
source_labels: R4 Sales Mix; R13 Sales Mix; YTD Sales Mix; LW RTL Mix %
evidence: S09 Export!I1:K1; S13 Export!E1:M1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Attribute/category net sales / net sales of the entire active global population.
grain_unit: Attribute value × period × global scope. Unit: %.
aggregation_guards: Local selected rows do not silently redefine denominator; show denominator scope.
decisions_questions: Denominator scope and net sales policy require client validation.

name: Assortment share
source_labels: SKU Mix
evidence: S09 Export!C1; S10 Export!C1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Attribute distinct ranged SKUs / total distinct ranged SKUs in scope as-of date.
grain_unit: Master attributes + range. Unit: %.
aggregation_guards: Optional exposure-weighted SKU-store-days share must be a separately named metric.
decisions_questions: Share of SKU count is observed; distinctness, as-of and denominator must be confirmed.

name: Assortment productivity index
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K34
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Sales share / assortment share.
grain_unit: Same attribute, universe and period policy. Unit: x.
aggregation_guards: Undefined if share denominator is zero. Supply availability and distribution must be visible alongside.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: Markdown rate
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K35
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Markdown discount dollars / original-ticket sales value of sold units under agreed client policy.
grain_unit: Transaction price history; definition pending. Unit: %.
aggregation_guards: Recompute ratio; distinguish markdown from promotional discount.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: Return rate
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K36
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Returned quantity from a sold cohort / original gross sold quantity for that cohort, within agreed return window.
grain_unit: Sale-to-return link; cohort maturity. Unit: %.
aggregation_guards: A return-processing-date ratio is a different operational measure; label separately.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: GMROI
source_labels: R4 GMROI; R13 GMROI
evidence: S15 Export!BQ1:BR1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Gross margin dollars / average inventory cost for the same period.
grain_unit: K03 and K09. Unit: x for period.
aggregation_guards: Show period; no silent annualization. Average inventory <=0 gives unavailable.
decisions_questions: Annualization and average inventory basis not supplied; do not equate source to proposed unannualized period GMROI. See K65 for an annualized base-case variant; do not assume source uses it.

name: Estimated lost sales
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K38
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Estimated unmet quantity during eligible stockout periods × relevant expected net selling price.
grain_unit: Availability + demand model + price. Unit: USD estimated.
aggregation_guards: Display model/version/range; avoid adding overlapped estimates across substitute SKUs without adjustment.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: Aged inventory and excess (prior combined concept; see K85 and K86)
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K39
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Aged: stock beyond chosen receipt-age threshold. Excess: max(0, projected supply − demand − approved safety stock) over chosen horizon.
grain_unit: Receipt lots, snapshot, open orders, forecast, policy. Unit: USD at cost.
aggregation_guards: Separate age and coverage concepts; calculate by SKU/store before summing excess.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure. Split aged (receipt age) from excess (projected supply/demand); observed OH/WOS are not proof of either measure.

name: Open exception cases
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration workbook KPI Library K40
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Count unresolved cases keyed by canonical SKU, normalized store scope, rule-set version and evaluation window. Show distinct SKUs separately.
grain_unit: Rules + case state; critical/high/watch mutually exclusive per case. Unit: distinct cases; SKUs secondary.
aggregation_guards: Primary tile counts cases. Multiple triggered rules attach as reasons to one case. Display evaluated population, exclusions and data coverage.
decisions_questions: Validate feasibility and governing policy with the client; no supplied source explicitly establishes this measure.

name: Last-week sales and fiscal rolling sales
source_labels: Last Week; LW Sales; R4 Sales; R13 Sales; R52 Sales; R4 Weekly Average; R13 Weekly Average; R52 Weekly Average
evidence: S08 scorecard and Top 20 table; S12 Export!B1:E1; S15 Export!M1:P1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Sum sales in each specified completed period; weekly average = window sales / included weeks.
grain_unit: SKU/store/category × fiscal week; USD or USD/week
aggregation_guards: Sum sales before dividing; rolling windows overlap and must not be added.
decisions_questions: R4/R13/R52 plausibly rolling weeks, but anchors, partial weeks, fiscal calendar and averaging bases unknown.

name: Sales and volume comparable growth
source_labels: LW Comp; MTD Comp; QTD Comp; YTD Comp; MTD SQFT Comp; QTD SQFT Comp; YTD SQFT Comp; YTD Growth
evidence: S08 scorecard; S09 Export!L1; S12 Export!I1:O1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: (Current matched-cohort total − prior comparable total) / positive prior total, separately for sales and compatible volume.
grain_unit: Same business hierarchy and comparable store cohort × fiscal period; %
aggregation_guards: Compute ratio of aggregate values; zero/negative baseline gives explicit no-comparable-base state; pp vs percent clearly labeled.
decisions_questions: Confirm Comp Flag, exclusions, 53-week mapping, open/closed stores and whether YTD Growth equals comp.

name: Comparable sales difference
source_labels: R52 Comp $ +/-; YTD Comp $; LW Sales Comp $; LY YTD Sales Comp $
evidence: S12 Export!P1; S15 Export!R1:U1,Y1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Current sales minus matched comparator sales, in dollars; preserve each named variant and comparator.
grain_unit: SKU or geography × matching fiscal window; USD
aggregation_guards: Compute additive difference after aligning cohort; never conflate a % with dollar change.
decisions_questions: Confirm whether fields refer to matched stores or all stores and exact comparator of LY-prefixed labels.

name: Square-foot sales and compatible quantity
source_labels: YTD SQFT; R4 SQFT; R13 SQFT; R52 SQFT Sales; SQFT Ratio
evidence: S09 Export!E1; S11 Export!E1:G1; S15 Export!AT1:AW1,CF1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Sum net sold square feet for each period using effective-dated SKU conversion from sales units.
grain_unit: SKU × store × date; sqft
aggregation_guards: Never combine sqft with each, carton or pallet; separately report return quantity and conversions.
decisions_questions: Confirm SQFT Ratio basis, conversion dates, return treatment and how non-area categories are represented.

name: Square-foot quantity mix
source_labels: R4 SQFT Mix; R13 SQFT Mix; YTD SQFT Mix
evidence: S09 Export!F1:H1; S15 Export!BD1:BF1; S16 Export!O1:Q1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Group net sold sqft divided by selected-parent total net sold sqft in the same window.
grain_unit: Attribute or hierarchy group × period; % of sqft
aggregation_guards: Aggregate quantity first; define parent denominator; negative returns and overlapping groups can distort shares.
decisions_questions: Confirm denominator, status, no/negative total, multi-valued attributes and period bounds.

name: Sales weekly productivity per location
source_labels: R4 Avg Sales PWPS; R13 Avg Sales PWPS; R52 Avg Sales PWPS
evidence: S06 New SKU and SKU Performance grids; S15 Export!H1:J1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Net sales divided by eligible store-weeks in the named period; report USD per eligible store-week.
grain_unit: SKU × eligible store-day × fiscal week; USD/store-week
aggregation_guards: Compute from underlying exposure; include eligible zero-sales stores; do not average SKU ratios.
decisions_questions: PWPS expansion and eligibility are not defined; sample S15 H2 is consistent with R4 Sales / 4 / Locations but is not general proof; K47 uses different count in same row.

name: Quantity weekly productivity per location
source_labels: R4 Avg SQFT/EA per PWPS; R13 Avg SQFT/EA per PWPS; R52 Avg SQFT PWPS; R13 Avg SQFT/EA per Location
evidence: S11 Export!B1; S15 Export!E1:G1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Net compatible sales quantity divided by eligible store-weeks in the named period, shown separately by UOM.
grain_unit: SKU × store-week; sqft or ea per eligible store-week
aggregation_guards: Aggregate numerator and exposure separately; preserve no sales, returns and stockout context.
decisions_questions: Confirm PWPS and denominator; S15 E2 matches R4 SQFT / 4 / ASTY Locations while H2 matches sales / 4 / Locations; evidence does not prove behavior beyond that example.

name: ELP
source_labels: AVG ELP
evidence: S05 district table; S06 New SKU and SKU Performance tables; S10 Export!L1; S11 Export!D1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Candidate: client-defined reference/everyday price averaged over a specified effective period/location.
grain_unit: SKU/location × effective pricing interval; USD per approved UOM
aggregation_guards: Do not sum unit prices, average row prices blindly, or equate to realized ASP.
decisions_questions: ELP expansion, reference price vs selling price, weighting, effective date and UOM unknown.

name: Chain/reference price
source_labels: Chain Price; Avg Unit Price; Avg SQFT/EA Price; SQF/EA PRICE
evidence: S01 Edge matrix; S04 inventory grid; S15 Export!B1,AR1:AS1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Store price separately per effective-dated SKU and UOM; present client-approved chain/reference price and distinct realized price.
grain_unit: SKU × location or chain × price effective date; USD/UOM
aggregation_guards: No averaging or summing without valid weights; S01 SQF/EA PRICE total seems implausible as a per-unit price and requires investigation.
decisions_questions: Confirm calculation, inclusion of discounts, standard vs actual price and price per each versus sqft.

name: Transactions
source_labels: R4 Transactions; R13 Transactions; R52 Transactions
evidence: S15 Export!AB1:AD1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Count distinct eligible transactions containing the SKU or in selected cohort and period.
grain_unit: Transaction ID × period × channel; count
aggregation_guards: Distinct counts are nonadditive across SKUs; preserve returns and cancellation policy.
decisions_questions: Determine transaction scope, basket identity, return-only transactions, online vs store and whether transaction counts are SKU-attributed.

name: Quantity per transaction
source_labels: R13 SQFT/Units per Trans; YTD SQFT/Units per Trans; LY YTD SQFT/Units per Trans
evidence: S15 Export!AH1:AJ1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Total net compatible sale quantity / distinct eligible transactions for same period.
grain_unit: SKU or category × transaction × period; sqft or units per transaction
aggregation_guards: Weighted ratio of total quantity and transaction count; avoid counting shared baskets twice.
decisions_questions: Confirm transaction denominator, return treatment, attribution and whether metric is sqft or each.

name: First cost
source_labels: First Cost; SQFT First Cost
evidence: S15 Export!AK1,AN1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Client-approved unit acquisition cost before separately stated freight, and cost / validated area conversion.
grain_unit: SKU × cost version/effective date × location; USD/each or USD/sqft
aggregation_guards: Do not sum per-unit rates; do not equate first cost to COGS without accounting policy.
decisions_questions: Actual vs standard, duty/rebate inclusions, effective date and conversion must be confirmed.

name: Freight cost
source_labels: Freight Cost; SQFT Freight Cost (Location); SQFT Freight Cost (Chain)
evidence: S15 Export!AL1,AO1:AP1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Client-approved allocated freight per saleable unit and sqft, with separate location and chain basis.
grain_unit: SKU × destination/cost version × date; USD/UOM
aggregation_guards: Do not average unweighted or double count freight already included in landed cost.
decisions_questions: Freight methodology, allocation, duties, currency and location vs chain weighting.

name: Landed cost
source_labels: Landed Cost; SQFT Landed Cost
evidence: S15 Export!AM1,AQ1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: First cost plus attributable freight and other client-approved landed components; divide by valid sqft conversion for area rate.
grain_unit: SKU × destination/cost version × date; USD/UOM
aggregation_guards: Use component costs once; S15 row 2 first + freight = landed is illustrative, not proof of universal DAX.
decisions_questions: Confirm duties, rebates, standard vs actual, inbound vs outbound and cost date.

name: On-hand retail value
source_labels: OH$ Retail; OH RTL$
evidence: S02 Focus Group and SKU tables; S05 district table
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Physical inventory on-hand × client-approved retail valuation at one as-of date.
grain_unit: SKU × location × inventory snapshot; USD retail
aggregation_guards: Snapshot, never sum across dates; distinct from cost value or sales.
decisions_questions: Retail basis (ticket/current price), negative stock, unavailable units and markdown policy.

name: On-hand cost value
source_labels: OH$ Cost; OH CST$; OH $; TOTAL OH$
evidence: S02 Focus Group table; S05 district table; S11 Export!O1; S15 Export!BL1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Physical on-hand quantity × approved inventory cost at one snapshot; only map OH $ without suffix after client confirms valuation.
grain_unit: SKU × location × inventory snapshot; USD cost
aggregation_guards: Snapshot, not a flow; separate store/DC and sellable/non-sellable; no assumed valuation for generic OH$.
decisions_questions: Valuation method; generic OH$ basis; negative stock, DC inclusion and period as-of.

name: Share of on-hand dollars
source_labels: %GT TOTAL OH$; % of OH $ of Non-Productive SKUs
evidence: S11 Export!P1; S15 Export!BM1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Group/SKU OH value / same-snapshot OH value of the explicitly named total cohort.
grain_unit: SKU or group × scope × as-of; %
aggregation_guards: Divide total values once; define whether denominator is overall or nonproductive cohort and cost or retail.
decisions_questions: Identify exact total scope, weighting, stock valuation, negative value and nonproductive filter rules.

name: Store and DC on-hand quantity
source_labels: Store OH Qty; DC OH Qty
evidence: S04 inventory grid
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: At a given snapshot, report physical on-hand for the SKU separately at a specific store and supplying DC.
grain_unit: SKU × location × as-of; compatible unit
aggregation_guards: Shared DC inventory must not be summed across each consuming store; negative OH is a data/adjustment state.
decisions_questions: Store/DC relationship, unit, timing, sellability and negative inventory policy.

name: DC to store open order quantity
source_labels: DC to Store OO Qty
evidence: S04 inventory grid
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Outstanding requested quantity from DC to the specified store, at snapshot, from confirmed relevant open order lines.
grain_unit: SKU × DC × destination store × open-order snapshot; units
aggregation_guards: Separate requested, allocated and in-transit; do not count same order as both PO and transfer.
decisions_questions: OO expansion, statuses, cancellation, ETA, transfer type and destination as-of.

name: On-order inventory value by destination
source_labels: On Order $ (DCs); On Order $ (Stores)
evidence: S15 Export!BN1:BO1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Sum open order remaining quantity × approved valuation per order line, split DC and store destinations as of snapshot.
grain_unit: SKU × open order line × destination × snapshot; USD
aggregation_guards: Exclude cancelled/received and avoid counting transfer legs or PO twice; values are not on-hand.
decisions_questions: Purchase vs transfer scopes, cost/retail valuation, ETA, status and duplicate pipeline.

name: DC to store WOS
source_labels: DC to Store WOS
evidence: S04 inventory grid
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Coverage of explicitly defined DC-to-store supply using an agreed matching weekly demand denominator.
grain_unit: SKU × destination × as-of; weeks
aggregation_guards: Display no positive demand explicitly; do not mix with store WOS or assume visible R4 rate is denominator.
decisions_questions: Numerator, demand horizon, store/DC association and zero denominator need confirmation.

name: Pallet quantity
source_labels: OH Pallet Qty; DC Pallet Qty
evidence: S04 inventory grid
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: On-hand quantity converted to pallets via effective SKU-specific pack/pallet quantity, separately for store and DC.
grain_unit: SKU × location × snapshot; pallets
aggregation_guards: Preserve fractional values and conversion version; shared DC stock cannot be multiplied across stores.
decisions_questions: Physical vs equivalent pallets, rounding and appropriate pack configuration.

name: MIP
source_labels: MIP; Average MIP
evidence: S04 inventory grid; S06 New SKU table; S11 Export!M1; S15 Export!BJ1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Opaque client metric/field: retain displayed value and do not assign an expansion or formula until a definition is supplied.
grain_unit: SKU/location × as-of or cohort; unit unknown
aggregation_guards: Do not convert to months or equate with minimum presentation based on acronym alone; average basis is unknown.
decisions_questions: Expand MIP; identify unit, date, calculation, aggregate weighting, and how MIP Sales By Location differs. MIP Sales By Location is a separate source measure; see K87.

name: Inventory turns
source_labels: R4 Turns; R13 Turns
evidence: S15 Export!BS1:BT1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Period COGS / average inventory cost, explicitly annualized only if chosen client policy and factor are documented.
grain_unit: SKU/location × specified period; turns
aggregation_guards: Use same period/cost and matching average inventory; do not mix annualized and period turns.
decisions_questions: Client calculation, factor 52/4 or 52/13, daily vs weekly stock and valuation.

name: Annualized GMROI
source_labels: R4 GMROI; R13 GMROI
evidence: S15 Export!BQ1:BR1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Annualized period gross margin / average inventory cost, if approved: period GM × (52 / included weeks) / average inventory cost.
grain_unit: SKU/location × period; annualized x
aggregation_guards: Keep distinct from K37 period GMROI; annualization factor/calendar must be visible; no valid ratio if avg inventory <= 0.
decisions_questions: Confirm whether source GMROI is annualized, period dates, gross margin cost and inventory averaging.

name: VP Avg
source_labels: VP Avg
evidence: S15 Export!BP1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Opaque source measure; hold without formula until owner provides definition and intended use.
grain_unit: Source SKU row; unit and time unknown
aggregation_guards: Do not infer expansion or use for automated ranking.
decisions_questions: What VP means, period, input, aggregation and validation?

name: Active assortment location count
source_labels: Active Assorted Locations; ASTY Locations
evidence: S06 SKU Performance table; S15 Export!L1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Count distinct locations at which SKU qualifies under approved effective-dated active-assortment definition.
grain_unit: SKU × store × as-of; distinct stores
aggregation_guards: Do not add counts across SKUs or confuse with Locations, selling locations or store-days.
decisions_questions: Confirm status codes, future stop date logic, location treatment and as-of.

name: Reporting location count
source_labels: Locations; # of Loc
evidence: S06 New SKU and SKU Performance tables; S11 Export!C1; S15 Export!K1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Count distinct locations included by a documented source population at the specified as-of or period.
grain_unit: SKU × store × period/as-of; distinct stores
aggregation_guards: Avoid summing across SKUs; display as-of and eligible/selling/active qualification.
decisions_questions: Which locations qualify, and why S15 row 2 volume and sales productivity may use different counts?

name: Store SKU count TY/LY
source_labels: TY; LY (SKU Count By Location matrix)
evidence: S14 Export!A1:C5; Export!VT1:VU5
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Distinct qualifying SKUs for each store/subdepartment at TY and comparable LY reference dates.
grain_unit: Store × subdepartment × reference date; distinct SKU
aggregation_guards: Store counts sum to SKU-store memberships, not chain-unique SKUs; matrix does not contain item membership.
decisions_questions: Determine status/eligibility, date alignment, closed-store treatment and any blanks/zeros.

name: Focus group membership and count
source_labels: Focus Group; SKU Count; Bulk Out; NPI; OP; Zero Sales R52
evidence: S02 Focus Group table
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Count distinct relevant entities in each focus group using dated membership rules; expose SKU versus SKU-location grain.
grain_unit: Focus-group entity × membership interval; SKU or SKU-store count
aggregation_guards: Do not sum overlaps as distinct products; never treat group membership as approved action.
decisions_questions: NPI/OP expansion; exclusivity, grouping grain, R52 definition and membership dates.

name: Bulk-out end date
source_labels: Bulk Out End Date; Active Bulkout
evidence: S02 SKU table and filter card
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Client-recorded expected end date for a bulk-out assignment; display days remaining using the date and a selected as-of.
grain_unit: SKU × location × bulk-out event; date or days
aggregation_guards: Show overdue separately; never infer status or completion solely from end date.
decisions_questions: Source owner, timezone, end-date semantics, updates, completion and scope.

name: Zero sales indicator
source_labels: Zero Sales R52; R52 $0 or Less
evidence: S02 Focus Group table; S06 top control
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Flag observed zero or nonpositive sales over a defined comparable trailing window, separately for exact zero vs <=0.
grain_unit: SKU × store scope × evaluation date; boolean
aggregation_guards: Do not equate net returns with no transactions; use valid eligible exposure and availability.
decisions_questions: Confirm R52 dates, monetary vs quantity basis, negative sales, status and scope.

name: Assortment lifecycle status
source_labels: Discontinued; Inactive; Leaving Program; Unknown; Assortment Status
evidence: S05 Assortment Status legend; S07 status selector; S11 Export!T1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Assign source lifecycle status to SKU/store context for its effective interval; preserve Unknown.
grain_unit: SKU × store or chain × effective interval; categorical
aggregation_guards: Status is not proof of current ranging, inventory, executed exit or merchant decision.
decisions_questions: Mappings, precedence, dates, chain vs store and leaving-program criteria.

name: Good / Better / Best tier
source_labels: GBB; Good; Better; Best; Opening Price Point
evidence: S03 top matrix; S15 Export!CI1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Display source-assigned price/quality tier at the effective SKU/category context, including OPP and unassigned.
grain_unit: SKU × category × tier version; categorical
aggregation_guards: Do not derive tier from current ASP or presume the realized prices are monotonic.
decisions_questions: Assignment authority, time history, business logic, unit and missing tiers.

name: Average ticket
source_labels: Avg. Ticket, Transactions & Traffic
evidence: S08 left navigation only
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Proposed average ticket = eligible transaction sales / distinct eligible transactions in same period and channel.
grain_unit: Store × period × channel; USD/transaction
aggregation_guards: Menu text only; underlying measure not shown. Distinct transactions nonadditive across SKU rows.
decisions_questions: Returns, basket allocation, customer/channel and formula; confirm value to assortment workflow.

name: Traffic
source_labels: Avg. Ticket, Transactions & Traffic
evidence: S08 left navigation only
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: No defensible numerical base formula from navigation label; obtain sensor, deduplication and unit definition.
grain_unit: Store × time interval; visits or other defined unit
aggregation_guards: Do not equate store traffic to unique customers, transactions or conversion.
decisions_questions: Actual report fields, source, time grain, privacy and scope.
placement: Retain store operations; optional contextual link

name: Budget and budget variance
source_labels: YTD Budget; YTD % to Bud; MTD % to Bud
evidence: S08 Overview scorecards (values blank)
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Use approved sales budget for matching period/cohort; variance = actual − budget; ratio definition needs decision.
grain_unit: Store/category × fiscal period × budget version; USD and %
aggregation_guards: Distinguish actual/budget % from (actual − budget)/budget; show missing not zero.
decisions_questions: Budget availability/version, fiscal phasing, matching cohort and source % definition.

name: Active Assorted flag
source_labels: Active Assorted Flag: Y = ASTY, ATXY, APXY, ATSY with no future stop date
evidence: S06 screenshot footer
base_definition: SOURCE TEXT: SOURCE TEXT: Y = ASTY, ATXY, APXY, ATSY with no future stop date; precise condition and time basis to confirm.
grain_unit: Source SKU/status context × effective date; Y/N
aggregation_guards: Do not assume this one footnote governs every report or that actual eligibility equals active status.
decisions_questions: Clarify whether no future stop date qualifies all codes, expand codes and determine store versus chain scope.

name: Average weekly sales by named cohort
source_labels: TOP 50 AVG WEEKLY SQFT; TOP 100 AVG WEEKLY SQFT; BOTTOM 25 AVG WEEKLY SQFT; BOTTOM 50 AVG WEEKLY SQFT
evidence: S05 top scorecard
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Rank a defined eligible entity cohort by specified average weekly sqft and average the selected N scores.
grain_unit: Defined cohort × period; average sqft/week
aggregation_guards: Keep negative quantities and small cohorts visible; weighting and tie handling matter.
decisions_questions: Entity ranking level, window, aggregate weighting, treatment of ties and negative volume unknown.
placement: Item or store ranking after validation

name: SKU sales ranking
source_labels: Top 20 SKUs - Sales; YTD Sales; LW Sales; R4 Weekly Avg $; R13 Weekly Average $
evidence: S08 Top 20 SKUs - Sales table
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Rank qualifying SKUs by selected-period sales, display top N with exact window and scope.
grain_unit: SKU × selected population × period; rank
aggregation_guards: Retain ties and zero/negative sales under policy; no causal interpretation.
decisions_questions: Ranking period, tie treatment, store scope, eligibility and N control.

name: Product cohort and status exposure
source_labels: New SKU Performance | ASTY < 9 MIP; Level 1; Assortment Status
evidence: S06 New SKU heading; S11 Export!applied filters
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Create a saved cohort with source predicates and exact operators, evaluated against dated master/status attributes.
grain_unit: SKU × effective date × source-defined MIP; cohort flag
aggregation_guards: S11 filter is Average of MIP >= 6 and is not blank; filename says greater than 6. Preserve exact rule and no inference on MIP meaning.
decisions_questions: Confirm SKU level, ASTY, replacement Y, ST, MIP semantics, and source-filter vs filename discrepancy.

name: Sales mix by lifecycle status
source_labels: Active Sales; Discontinued Sales; Disco Sales Mix; LP Sales; LP Sales Mix
evidence: S07 top scorecards and Assortment Status selector
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Sum period sales for a defined lifecycle status; mix = that status sales / total sales of same scope and period.
grain_unit: Status × SKU/store × fiscal period; USD and %
aggregation_guards: Observed cards are blank; do not treat missing as zero. Status should be effective-dated for sales transactions.
decisions_questions: LP and discontinued mappings, status at sale vs current, and mix denominator.

name: Lost-demand evidence availability-adjusted velocity
source_labels: None
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration K13/K38 and S04 inventory detail
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Proposed net sold quantity on eligible in-stock days / in-stock eligible store-weeks, supplemented by separately labeled estimated lost sales.
grain_unit: SKU × store × day; units/store-week and estimated USD
aggregation_guards: Never claim true unconstrained demand or add overlapping substitute estimates without adjustment.
decisions_questions: Confirm in-stock thresholds, stockout history and model validity; optional advanced analytics.

name: Revenue per transaction / average basket
source_labels: Avg. Ticket, Transactions & Traffic; R4 Transactions
evidence: S08 navigation; S15 Export!AB1:AD1
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Proposed net sales / distinct matching transaction count, with store-level and SKU-attributed basket definitions kept separate.
grain_unit: Store/category/SKU × period; USD/transaction
aggregation_guards: Cross-SKU transaction deduplication is mandatory and scope cannot be silently substituted.
decisions_questions: Confirm whether navigation page has a displayed average ticket and its formula; SKU sales and all-store transactions are different cohorts.

name: Aged inventory
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration K39; no client age field or formula visible
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: Sum stock value of units whose elapsed age since agreed receipt or age-start event exceeds a configurable threshold.
grain_unit: SKU × receipt lot × location × snapshot; units or USD at agreed cost.
aggregation_guards: Count each stock unit once; disclose receipt-age threshold and distinguish age from excess.
decisions_questions: Need lot-level age, age reset, transfer treatment, threshold and value basis.

name: Excess inventory
evidence: Prior Hindsight configuration K39; S02/S04 show related stock and WOS but not an excess definition.
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: max(0, projected supply over a selected horizon minus projected demand and approved safety stock), valued at agreed cost.
grain_unit: SKU × store/DC scope × horizon and snapshot; units or USD.
aggregation_guards: Calculate at appropriate SKU/location grain before summing; distinguish on-hand, inbound, shared DC stock and age.
decisions_questions: Forecast, horizon, replenishment timing, safety stock, cancellations and client excess policy need sign-off.

name: MIP Sales By Location
source_labels: MIP Sales By Location
evidence: S06 New SKU Performance table
base_definition: INFERRED BASE CASE: A client-defined sales measure associated with MIP and location. Its window, aggregation and exact semantics are not visible; preserve the source value until defined.
grain_unit: Source SKU × location or location-aggregate; USD inferred from display.
aggregation_guards: Do not assume MIP is months, a display quantity, or a time window; do not sum location averages.
decisions_questions: Expand MIP, define calculation and location denominator, sales window, and aggregation.
